header: A year of building rather than buying
lead: The cheapest megawatt hour is the one we do not have to buy at nine in the morning in January.
bodytext:
Nineteen years of the same argument finally settled it: a regional supplier that owns nothing generates its margin from timing, and timing is not something you can promise a customer. So 2026 went into concrete and cable rather than into procurement.

None of the four figures beside this paragraph is impressive on its own. Together they are the first year since 1998 in which we spent more on our own network than on electricity bought from somebody else's.
note: All figures as at 31 December 2026, from the audited annual accounts published on 31 March 2027.
